title: US voters in Harwood, North Dakota rejected a ballot measure that opposed Applied Digital's $3B data center, set to open in 2027, bucking a nationwide backlash (Miriam Waldvogel/Washington Post)

contentText:
Miriam Waldvogel / Washington Post :

US voters in Harwood, North Dakota rejected a ballot measure that opposed Applied Digital's $3B data center, set to open in 2027, bucking a nationwide backlash   —  On Election Day, much of the country turned against the massive projects that power AI.  Here's why one place didn't.  —  SummaryLoading...
